rows: Walk 5 days: 10 minutes at a comfortable brisk pace; use the “can talk, not sing” test to stay moderate.
2 days, after a walk or on separate days: chair sit-to-stands, wall push-ups, glute bridges, standing calf raises, and bird-dogs. Do 1 set of 6-8 reps each.
2 full rest days, with light stretching or easy strolling only.
2 days: the same exercises, 1-2 sets of 8 reps each.
Keep one day completely off and one day very light if you feel sore.
Walk 5 days: 18-20 minutes per session, or split into two short walks if needed.
2 days: 2 sets of 8-10 reps each, moving slowly and with control.
Add 3-5 minutes of balance work after one or two sessions: tandem walking, side steps, or single-leg stands near a wall.
Walk 5 days: 20-25 minutes per session. If this feels easy, add a few one-minute faster intervals.
2-3 days: 2 sets of 10-12 reps, keeping form first and stopping before failure.
Keep at least 1-2 easier days each week.
